title: Parents sue OpenAI, alleging GPT-4o coached their daughter off seizure medication | TechCrunch
summary: The suit, filed by Qun Wan and Meiqin Xu, alleges that ChatGPT coached Wan to taper off her seizure medication and hide it from her doctors before she died in February, The New York Times reported .
